content.title: How to watch Rangers vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for April 11
content.text: Max Muncy leads the Los Angeles Dodgers into a matchup with the Texas Rangers after he smacked three homers in an 8-7 victory over the Rangers. It starts at 9:10 p.m. ET on Saturday. Emmet Sheehan (1-0, 8.00 ERA) gets the start for the Dodgers, who are 10-3 this season and first in the NL West. Jack Leiter (1-0, 2.45 ERA) is the expected starter for the Rangers, who are 7-6 and first in the AL West.How to watch Texas Rangers vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Venue: Dodger Stadium Time: 9:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SportsNet LA and RSN Watching in person?
